verdict.rationale: vLLM's own docs explicitly list a broad quantization stack spanning very-low-bit (INT4, MXFP4, GPTQ/AWQ, GGUF) through 8-bit (INT8, FP8), directly matching the story. missing for 10: independent/hands-on benchmarks confirming actual memory-footprint reduction and quality at these low-bit levels (the one community comment referencing 4-bit unsupported is from 2023 and predates current INT4/GPTQ/AWQ support, so it doesn't concretely dispute current capability).
